license_required.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of providing real estate services or hold himself or herself out to the public in this State as being qualified to practice the same; or use in connection with that person's name, or otherwise assume or use, any title or description conveying or tending to convey the impression that the person is qualified to practice real estate services, unless such person has been duly licensed under this chapter.

type.quote: The Commission shall consist of 9 members appointed by the Governor: 5 professional members, 3 of whom shall be licensed brokers, 1 associate broker, and 1 salesperson; and 4 public members.

interval_years.quote: On or before the biennial date established by the Division, each licensee shall make application to the Commission for a renewal of license and make payment of the fees prescribed by the Division.
interval_years.citation: § 2910. Issuance and renewal of licenses; additional licenses; reinstatement.

required.quote: each licensee applying for renewal shall be required to successfully complete in the 2-year period prior to the established renewal date continuing education hours in an amount and subject matter as prescribed by the rules and regulations of the Commission.
required.citation: § 2910. Issuance and renewal of licenses; additional licenses; reinstatement.

available.quote: the Commission shall grant a license to an applicant who shall present proof of current licensure in "good standing" in another state, the District of Columbia, or territory of the United States

requirements.value: Applicant must present proof of current licensure in good standing in another state, DC, or US territory; meet good standing requirements per § 2907(a)(2),(3),(4); and for broker/associate broker must be at least 23, meet experience and education requirements per rules and regulations, and pass the state portion of the Delaware broker examination.
requirements.quote: Upon payment of the appropriate fee and submission and acceptance of a written application on forms provided by the Commission, and subject to the further requirements set forth in this section, the Commission shall grant a license to an applicant who shall present proof of current licensure in "good standing" in another state, the District of Columbia, or territory of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false promise likely to influence, persuade, or induce
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has made any false promise of a character likely to influence, persuade or induce

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or making false promises
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has pursued a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or the making of false promises through licensees or advertising or otherwise

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing within a reasonable time to account for or remit money belonging to others
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed, within a reasonable time, to account for or to remit any money coming into the licensee's possession which belongs to others
Has illegally practiced real estate services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetently or negligently practicing real estate services in a manner that does not safeguard the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has incompetently or negligently practiced real estate services in such manner as to not safeguard the interest of the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying a commission to any person for acts performed in violation of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has paid a commission or valuable consideration to any person for acts or services performed in violation of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting a person in providing real estate services who does not hold a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has assisted a person in providing real estate services who does not hold a license to provide real estate services in this State.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a provision of this chapter, rules and regulations, or any order of the Commission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated a provision of this chapter, any of the rules and regulations established thereunder, or any order of the Commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving or arranging to receive undisclosed valuable consideration for products or services relating to a transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has received or made an arrangement or agreement to receive, directly or indirectly, any form of valuable consideration for products or services relating to a real estate services transaction without prior written disclosure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresenting the availability or content of any statutorily required form
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has misrepresented the availability of or the content of any statutorily required form such as the seller's disclosure of real property condition report form and/or the radon disclosure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or cooperating in fraud or deception to acquire or renew a license, impersonating a licensee, or allowing another to use one's license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed or knowingly cooperated in fraud or material deception in order to acquire a license or renew a license as a real estate service provider; has impersonated another individual holding a license, or has allowed another individual to use that licensee's license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a crime substantially related to the practice of real estate services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of a crime that is substantially related to the practice of real estate services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a real estate license suspended, revoked, or other disciplinary action taken in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license as a real estate service provider suspended or revoked, or other disciplinary action taken by the appropriate licensing authority in another jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the Commission of out-of-state license discipline, surrender, suspension, or revocation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to notify the Commission that the licensee's license as a real estate service provider in another jurisdiction has been subject to discipline, or has been surrendered, suspended or revoked.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A broker applying for an office in the State of Delaware shall submit an application to the Commission for an office permit with the application fee established by the Division. A permit shall be issued only upon approval by the Commission.
establishment_regulation_required.citation: § 2919. Maintenance of place of business; office permits.

definition_quote.value: "Real estate services" means those activities performed by a licensee as defined in this chapter. As promulgated under the rules and regulations, real estate services shall also include the marketing and advertising of properties for sale or lease.
definition_quote.quote: "Real estate services" means those activities performed by a licensee as defined in this chapter. As promulgated under the rules and regulations, real estate services shall also include the marketing and advertising of properties for sale or lease.

value: negotiate the purchase, sale, or exchange of real estate
lease or rent or offer for rent any real estate
marketing and advertising of properties for sale or lease
methods_authorized.quote: to sell or offer to sell, or to buy or offer to buy, or to negotiate the purchase, sale, or exchange of real estate, or to lease or rent or offer for rent any real estate, or to negotiate leases or rental agreements thereof or of the improvements thereon for others.

license_tiers.quote: "Licensee" means an individual licensed under this chapter as a broker, associate broker or salesperson without implying what legal relationship they have with a customer or client.

broker_of_record_required.quote: Nothing in this chapter, however, shall prevent such brokerage organization from providing real estate services provided the individual or business entity has a broker who is responsible for providing real estate services and who may have affiliated associate brokers or salespersons

required_instruction_topics.quote: Has successfully completed a prescribed prelicensing course of instruction including real estate principles and practices and Delaware real estate law.
required_instruction_topics.citation: § 2907. Qualifications of applicant; application; examination; report to Attorney General; judicial review.

agency_relationship_types.quote: Every licensee shall be presumed to be a statutory agent and may refer to themselves as agent or statutory agent unless specifically identified as a common law agent in their brokerage agreement.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: The presumption of agency may be rebutted by the consumer signing a consumer information statement establishing a different agency relationship.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: The broker may from time to time designate 1 or more associate brokers or salespersons licensed under that broker to be the designated associate broker or associate brokers or salesperson or salespersons of a client or clients to the exclusion of all others in the brokerage organization.
designated_agency_permitted.citation: § 2936. Broker, associate broker and salesperson as a statutory agent.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: The consumer information statement required by this chapter shall be delivered to the consumer no later than the earlier of: (1) The first scheduled appointment; (2) The first showing of a property; or (3) Making an offer

written_service_agreement_required.quote: Nothing in this chapter obligates a buyer, tenant, seller or landlord to pay compensation to a broker or brokerage organization unless that party has entered into a written brokerage agreement with the broker or brokerage organization specifying the compensation terms.

escrow_account_required.quote: Every broker shall establish and maintain an escrow account or accounts in a federally insured banking institution which has offices within the State.
escrow_account_required.citation: § 2923. Deposits and escrow accounts; accounting; records inspection and audit.

escrow_deposit_deadline_business_days.quote: The broker shall deposit the moneys into the broker's escrow account within 72 hours of the signing of the written agreement by all parties, or by the dates defined therein, excluding weekends and federal holidays.
escrow_deposit_deadline_business_days.citation: § 2923. Deposits and escrow accounts; accounting; records inspection and audit.

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: each account shall be used only for escrow deposits, earnest money deposits, rental money or other moneys in which broker's customers or clients have an interest where such money is to be held by broker in accordance with the terms of a real estate services transaction.
commingling_of_funds_prohibited.citation: § 2923. Deposits and escrow accounts; accounting; records inspection and audit.

fixed_office_required.quote: The broker shall maintain an office approved by the Commission or by the state of licensure.
fixed_office_required.citation: § 2919. Maintenance of place of business; office permits.

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: The branch office, any licensees associated with the office and the designated on-site supervisor shall be under the direction and supervision of the broker.
branch_office_associate_broker_required.citation: § 2919. Maintenance of place of business; office permits.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: No terminated licensee shall perform any real estate services or engage directly or indirectly in providing real estate services until the Commission, in its discretion, shall issue a new license showing a new broker and a new approved business location.
salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.citation: § 2921. Notice and procedure on termination of licensee's employment; new license as prerequisite to resumption; inactive status.

qualified_association_permitted.quote: The broker or brokerage organization may pay the licensee's individual compensation to an entity created by the licensee to receive compensation providing the entity is either already approved by the Commission as a brokerage organization or the entity does not need to be approved because it does not engage in the brokerage business but is only established for business purposes to receive the licensee's compensation.

recovery_fund_exists.quote: The Commission shall establish and maintain a Real Estate Guaranty Fund (hereinafter referred to as the "Fund") from which, subject to this section, any person who obtains a final judgment against a licensee for loss or damage sustained by reason of theft or forgery (as defined in Title 11) or by reason of any fraud, misrepresentation or deceit by or on the part of any such licensee or any employee thereof who does not hold a license, may recover

recovery_fund_max_per_claim.quote: compensation in an amount not exceeding in the aggregate the sum of $25,000 in connection with any 1 transaction or claim, regardless of the number of persons aggrieved or parcels of real estate involved in such transaction or claim.

broker_price_opinion_permitted.quote: A CMA may also be referred to as a comparative market analysis, a comparable market analysis, a broker price opinion or broker's market analysis.

comparative_market_analysis_permitted.quote: A licensee may perform a competitive market analysis as part of providing real estate services.

license_exemptions.quote: This chapter shall not apply to: (1) Any person or a subsidiary or division thereof with common ownership or control who, as owner or lessor or buyer or lessee, performs any of the acts enumerated in this section with reference to property owned, purchased or leased by such person
